_hashedApiKeysPathWarning: Warning: to move the api keys' file, move the file itself first, then change hashedApiKeysPath, then run apply. With no file at the new path, apply takes the machine for a first install: it makes a new first key under a new password, and hands nginx a list that holds only that key, so every key your clients hold stops working. The feature README's Configure section says so too.
_hashedApiKeysMapPathWarning: Warning: after changing hashedApiKeysMapPath, run apply straight away, with no other command of the tool before it. nginx reads its list of the keys' hashes at the old path until apply rewrites its configuration, while add-api-key and remove-api-key write the list at the new one. So a key that remove-api-key removed in between would keep working. The feature README's Configure section says so too.
